title: IVG Smart Max Lemon & Lime Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Lemon and Lime combines two sharp citrus notes into one zesty vape. The Lemon adds a bright, citrusy tang while the Lime brings a slightly sweeter edge, creating a clean, punchy profile that fans of sour or fizzy flavours will appreciate. Each pod pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the refill chamber automatically feeds the pod during use, potentially supporting up to 10,000 puffs depending on vaping habits. The pod uses mesh coil technology for smooth vapour and a reliable mouth-to-lung draw. Compatible only with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
